messages:
Alex: Quick async standup — wrapping the midnight handoff.
What I did: triaged the burst of 503s on /generate, traced it to aggressive KV cache eviction around 00:18. Lowered batch window and rolled back async prefetch.
Blockers: need agreement on temporary alert handling for 99th SLO to avoid noisy pages during short bursts.
Today: running a targeted load test, will follow up with a canary deploy of the new batching config.

Maria: Thanks — can you paste the alert IDs and the runbook link?

Alex: ALERT-6723, ALERT-6724. Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/slo-503s
Logs quick grep: ```kubectl logs -n runtime inference-rt-3 --tail=200 | grep cache_evict```

Chris: Oncall saw the alerts at ~00:21, muted ALERT-6724 for 30m to cut noise while Alex investigates. :white_check_mark: I'll keep an eye on error budget windows.

Drew: FYI I pushed a patch to runtime batching (`batch_window_ms=20`) in prod-config repo — PR #734. Could slightly change throughput; monitor latency P95/P99.

Alex: Noted. Can we bump the SLO alert threshold from 0.3% to 0.6% for the next 6 hours? Otherwise short bursts will page us.

Maria: Prefer temporary mutes + dashboard annotation instead of changing SLOs. If it persists we'll start a postmortem.

Chris: Agree with Maria. Muted for now and adding annotation. If regression sustains >30m we'll escalate.

oncall-bot: Muted ALERT-6724 for 30 minutes (muted by Chris). Incident created: INC-2026.

Alex: Running load test now (plan: https://internal/tests/load/batch-window) — will post results in ~15m.

Drew: Noted — I also saw a small uptick in embedding cache misses around the same window. Opening follow-up ticket.

Alex: Load test finished: p95 latency down ~12%, p99 ~unchanged. No new 503s in last 10m. Sample log: ```[00:45] INFO cache_evict key=kv-abc size=1```
Recommendation: keep `batch_window_ms=20` for now and monitor for 2-3 deploy cycles.

Drew: I'll add a short alert for embedding cache miss ratio >2% in 10m so we can catch regressions separately.

Maria: I'll update the runbook with guidance for temporary mutes and when to escalate.

Chris: Good work all. If load test flips and errors return, revert PR #734 and unmute accordingly.

Alex: Thanks team — handoff complete. /wave
